title: TrailGenic Walking Conditioning Dataset
description: Canonical aggregate plus selected-session TrailGenic conditioning module for standardized Foundation walking economy. It does not expose raw telemetry.

selected_sessions.interpretation: Descriptive single-session result under heat and no-electrolyte context.

records.mechanism: Cardiac Efficiency Index improved across standardized fasted flat walking, indicating lower cardiovascular cost per mile at matched distance.

aggregate_finding.interpretation: Lower CEI at a comparable distance is consistent with improved walking economy in this subject; context and repeatability remain necessary.

hr_drift_percent.interpretation: Small positive drift is normal for flat Zone-1 walking.

methodology.metric_formula: CEI = average heart rate / distance in miles
methodology.comparison_frame: longitudinal comparison across 21 standardized walking sessions
methodology.control_frame: fasted, flat Foundation walking at approximately matched 3.17-mile distance
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only; not a biological-age measure.

claims: The best observed CEI was 30.3 HR/mi versus a 34.7 baseline at matched distance.
The aggregate CEI distribution remained in a tight 30.3-35.3 HR/mi range across the block.
All 21 published sessions were recorded as recovery-ready; this is an observational label, not clinical clearance.
This dataset is a conditioning signal and does not compute or imply biological age.
